description: Fabric client mod for Minecraft 26.2 that colors player/entity hitboxes by town/nation/ally/enemy relationship, using Aechronis's Nodes map API. GPLv3 port of the hitbox-coloring feature from oreotrollturbo's CrusalisUtils.

mods.name: Aechronis Hitboxes
mods.description: Colors player and entity hitboxes by relationship (town/nation/ally/enemy) using Aechronis's Nodes map API. A stripped-down, from-source GPLv3 port of the hitbox-coloring feature from oreotrollturbo's CrusalisUtils (itself a fork of Hitbox+), retargeted from Crusalis to Aechronis.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- F3+G corner-pillar lines (the grid lines around, not just under, your current chunk) now recolor correctly by territory relation. Root cause: the pillar redirect captured its chunk origin as two ordinal-indexed \`@Local double\` values; each \`double\` consumes two local-variable slots, and the second ordinal capture was landing on unrelated data in practice - pillars were resolving territory hundreds of chunks away from where they were actually drawn, so they'd never match the real territory underneath them. Fixed by capturing the method's single \`SectionPos\` local instead (unambiguous, no ordinal needed) and deriving the origin from it directly.
- \`mapLink\` cross-thread visibility fix carried over from v1.2.4.

### Changed
- Removed the diagnostic logging added while chasing both this bug and an unrelated "mod doesn't run on Aechronis" report that turned out to be a stale jar, not a real issue.

This closes out the F3+G recoloring work - both the current-chunk grid and the surrounding corner pillars now match relation coloring.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- \`mapLink\` was a plain static field written on the render thread but read from a background scheduler thread on periodic data refreshes - same cross-thread visibility bug class as earlier fixes this cycle. Now \`volatile\`.

### Added
- Unconditional logging at mod init and at the top of the server-join handler, before any host-matching logic runs. Lets a support log distinguish "mod never initialized" from "initialized but join event/host match failed."
- Re-added the throttled F3+G corner-pillar chunk/territory diagnostic log for the ongoing investigation into corner-pillar lines not recoloring.

### Known issue (actively investigating)
- On at least one client setup (Lunar Client), this mod's entrypoint appears to never execute at all - no crash, no error, but zero log output including the new init-time log, while other third-party mods initialize normally in the same session. Suspected cause: Lunar Client silently declining to run ESP-adjacent mod code as an anti-cheat/integrity measure, independent of which server is joined. Not yet confirmed against a non-Lunar Fabric install.

A stripped-down, from-source GPLv3 port of the hitbox-coloring feature from oreotrollturbo's CrusalisUtils (itself a fork of Hitbox+), retargeted from Crusalis to Aechronis.

releases.notes:
### Fixed
- Default hitbox opacity computed to ~1/255 (effectively invisible) for every category out of the box. The only thing actually visible was vanilla's own hardcoded red eye-height marker, which had been mistaken for a coloring bug. Defaults now render fully opaque.
- Relation resolution now falls back to a resident's town->nation link when their own `nation` field is stale/null.
- `world.json` parsing no longer requires a `core` field that some Nodes forks omit.
- Null-safety fix in resident name parsing.
- Cross-thread visibility fix (`volatile`) on territory/town data shared between the background data-fetch thread and the render thread.
- Added the missing `MAJOR_LINES` recolor for F3+G (vanilla's dominant grid color), previously only 2 of 3 relevant fields were redirected.

### Changed
- Server activation and map data source are hardcoded per-release again instead of runtime-configurable. Supporting a new server means a new release, not exposing an arbitrary URL/host field to players.
- Removed diagnostic logging added during troubleshooting.

### Known issue
- F3+G corner-pillar lines (the grid lines around, not under, your current chunk) may still render in vanilla's default color rather than the relation color - unconfirmed as of this release.

releases.notes:
## Changes since v1.0.0
- Added back the auto `/t spawn` on respawn feature from upstream CrusalisUtils (off by default - toggle in the config screen under "aechronis"). Fixed a real bug in the process: upstream's "just respawned" flag was never reset, so it only ever fired once per session. This version resets it on every death, so it fires every time.
- Bug-scan pass over the whole codebase; fixed a Java 20+ deprecation (`new URL(...)` -> `URI.create(...).toURL()`).

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.2
- Fabric Loader >= 0.19.3
- Fabric API 0.157.0+26.2
- Cloth Config 26.2.155+fabric
- Mod Menu 20.0.1 (optional - only needed for the in-game settings screen)

mixinextras-fabric is bundled inside the jar, no separate install needed.
